steps: Be a Fort Financial Credit Union member and register for the Refer-A-Friend program to get your personal referral link
Share your referral link with friends, family, or on social media
Friend opens a new checking account via your link
Friend completes within 90 days: $25 minimum opening deposit, at least $250 in direct deposits, and 25 debit-card transactions
You both receive a $100 Visa Reward Card within 4-6 weeks
